selection_metric: Equal-case arithmetic mean of intended-effect intensity ON minus exact matched OFF in finished images; higher wins.
comparison_policy: Retain negative gains, native zeros and exact ties. Technical failures are missing evidence, not zero. No teacher-SSE, preservation, beauty, confidence or completion selector/tiebreak. Reuse completed searches, checkpoints, proofs, outputs and first scores; no additional fresh confirmation or worse-arm completion.
measurement_kind: Frozen model instrument (SigLIP2), not human or statistical validation.
